messages:
maria: FYI we're doing a preflight for kernel v3.16-quant in the late window. tiny rollout, focus on thermal/kv-cache.
aj: good. pin TTL?
maria: sticky-pin 45m. canary slices s-1010 (eu) + s-1011 (us) 0.5% each.
sasha: release note stub at /docs/release-notes/kernel-3.16.md. callout: experimental fused-gemm path.
zane: adding thermal and kv cache probes. alerts to #eng-oncall and pager after 2m unacked.
maria: rollback conditions:
- thermal_temp_gpu > 85C for 2m across canary hosts
- OR kv_cache_evictions rate spike > baseline * 3 for 5m
- OR request_error_rate +2pp sustained 3m
aj: add auto-rollback if pinned > 40m without improvement.
deploybot: DeployBot: starting canary kernel@3.16-quant -> s-1010 (eu-west-1) 0.5%.
sasha: ops checklist short:
1) run smoke call with short prompts
2) run a 2048-token synthetic separately
3) watch thermal and kv_cache graphs
maria: note - exclude dedicated tenants from canary. will run staged post-night expansion if green.
zane: synthetic 2048 test queued to staging; will post results in 10m.
deploybot: DeployBot: canary healthy for first 3m. holding.
sasha: staging synthetic 2048 result: p99 exec_time 240ms (up from 90ms baseline) WARN slow-path.
aj: ugh. that's a regression. do we see thermal/kv issues?
zane: thermal nominal 72C, kv_cache 1.1GB used. only perf regression on long seq.
maria: per plan, immediate rollback on long-seq perf regressions in staging canary. executing: `deploybot rollback --release kernel@3.16 --scope=s-1010`
deploybot: DeployBot: rollback initiated for kernel@3.16 scope s-1010. notifying channels.
aj: good call. schedule a follow-up postmortem and tweak the fused-gemm fallback.
sasha: I'll add note in release draft documenting the long-seq fallback and next steps.
maria: thanks. we'll re-open after a fix; holding off on broader rollout. :eyes:
